conditions.without-skill: independent fresh-history agent, instructed not to load the skill or other skill bodies
conditions.with-skill: independent fresh-history agent, given the same brief and relevant frozen skill references

model_control: same inherited Codex model; no model overrides; exact backend model identifier not exposed by harness
budget: one first complete implementation per condition; self-check compile/runtime corrections permitted; no cross-candidate feedback before freeze
shared_input: BRIEF.md plus immutable shared fixture; no external assets or design service
screenshot_state: initial English; Music60, Sfx80, reduced_motion false, modal open
image_processing: Desktop: identical crop (260,40)-(1020,760), uniformly reduced with rounding. Portrait: full frame at native size. Only external captions, resampling and WebP encoding; UI pixels are not retouched.
known_issue: With-skill portrait Extended labels: motion label (y515,height75) intersects helper text (y561,height20). Frozen first-pass source is retained.
limitations: One pair under one brief is not evidence of a general causal improvement.
Exact model backend and random seed are not pinned.
Headless checks are technical evidence; screenshots and genuine browser input are separate.
An early screenshot-size mismatch was recaptured; fast popup input required a normal held pointer click. These were capture/harness issues, not source corrections.
